Notes: Use KEDA for queue-depth-driven scaling; Karpenter for fast node provisioning on AWS.

Strengths: Reduces handshake overhead, prevents DB connection exhaustion
Notes: Use a proxy pool (PgBouncer) in front of Postgres; per-pod pool size = (db_max / total_pods).

Pitfalls: Unbounded queues silently buffering until OOM
Notes: Reactive Streams (Project Reactor / RxJava) and Tokio mpsc enforce this naturally.

Use Case: One slow tenant/dep saturates a shared pool
Pitfalls: Sharing one HTTP client pool across all downstreams
Notes: Per-downstream HTTP clients + per-tenant rate limits.

Use Case: Tail latency dominated by slow replicas / single-flight cache loads
Weaknesses: Doubles request load; risk of duplicate side-effects
Keywords: hedged request tail latency single flight
Notes: See 'The Tail at Scale' (Dean & Barroso). Cap hedged rate (~5%).

Pitfalls: Sticky LB for stateless services that don't need it
Keywords: l4 l7 nlb alb envoy haproxy nginx anycast
Notes: Prefer L7 for HTTP (header-based routing); L4 for raw TCP/UDP.
Use 'stale-while-revalidate' + signed URLs for private cacheable assets.

Strengths: Lower latency per region; failure isolation
Weaknesses: Cross-region writes are expensive; conflict handling
Notes: Choose multi-region only when cross-region latency / DR / residency demands it; cost ~2-3×.

Use Case: Spiky synchronous load that downstream can't absorb
Weaknesses: Adds eventual consistency; UX must reflect async
Keywords: queue load levelling sqs kafka rabbit
Notes: Pair with idempotency keys + dead-letter queues.

Use Case: Slow queries from missing indexes / bad plans
Notes: Add 'covering' indexes ('INCLUDE') for hot read paths in Postgres.

Pitfalls: Refreshing on every write at scale
Notes: Refresh via CDC events or scheduled refresh; cap fan-out.

Strengths: Faster vacuum, easier retention, parallel scans
Weaknesses: Partition pruning misses if predicates miss partition key
Pitfalls: Hash-partitioning when range would suit time-series
Notes: For time-series, range-partition by day/week + drop old partitions for retention.
